ruleDefinitions.name: Potentially Suspicious ODBC Driver Registered
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the registration of a new ODBC driver where the driver is located in a potentially suspicious location Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\SOFTWARE\\\\ODBC\\\\ODBCINST\\\.INI\\\\.*") AND (registry_path = RGX("\\\\Driver$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\Setup$")) AND (Details = RGX(".*\\:\\\\PerfLogs\\\\.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\:\\\\ProgramData\\\\.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Registration\\\\CRMLog.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\com\\\\dmp\\\\.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\FxsTmp\\\\.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\Microsoft\\\\Crypto\\\\RSA\\\\MachineKeys\\\\.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\spool\\\\drivers\\\\color\\\\.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\spool\\\\PRINTERS\\\\.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\spool\\\\SERVERS\\\\.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\Tasks\\_Migrated\\\\.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\Tasks\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\SyncCenter\\\\.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\com\\\\dmp\\\\.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\FxsTmp\\\\.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\Tasks\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\PLA\\\\System\\\\.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\Tasks\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\SyncCenter\\\\.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Tasks\\\\.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Tracing\\\\.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Roaming\\\\.*")))
